approach: Approach via the Staircase / North Fork Skokomish trail (7.5 mi to Flapjack Lakes, ~3,100 ft gain) to Flapjack Lakes, then off-trail into the Sawtooth Ridge to the base of the climbing. Usually an overnight trip. CURRENT STATUS (verified via NPS trail conditions, updated 6/5/26): both the North Fork Skokomish River Trail and the Flapjack Lakes Trail are closed due to the 2025 Bear Gulch Fire, with no reopening date announced as of mid-2026 — confirm the trail (not just the Staircase road/campground) is open before planning a trip. A largely abandoned alternate line follows an old trail up the south end of Sawtooth Ridge, starting about 2.4 miles up the Staircase/North Fork Skokomish trail; it has been in poor condition and rarely used since the 1985 Beaver Fire.
